gloss: right in the middle of; in the midst of

definitions.gloss: right in the middle of; in the midst of
definitions.explanation: Indicates being at the very center or peak of an ongoing situation, season, or activity. Adds emphasis to 只中 through the intensifying prefix 真っ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}だ。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang right in the middle of exam studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{変革|へんかく}→変革：12100_henkaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The company is right in the midst of major transformation.

notes:
An emphatic form of {只中|ただなか} (the middle of), intensified by the prefix {真|ま}っ. Used to stress that something is at its peak or that one is deeply immersed in a situation. Very common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be right in the middle of
- {真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be in the midst of
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}: the height of summer
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}: in the thick of work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧: in the middle of — more neutral, commonly used for actions in progress
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: the very center — refers to physical location rather than a situation or time period
- ⟦{渦中|かちゅう}→渦中：13348_kachuu⟧: in the midst of (a controversy) — implies being caught up in something turbulent
